head_coach.name: Dick Advocaat
head_coach.play_style_summary: Advocaat implements a highly organized and structured system built on defensive compactness, efficient possession buildup from the back, and rapid transitions. His tactical setup typically alternates between a progressive 4-2-3-1 or 4-3-3 and a disciplined low block that leverages fast wide outlets when facing higher-ranked nations.

key_players.name: Armando Obispo
key_players.performance_stats: During the 2025/2026 Eredivisie campaign with PSV Eindhoven, he maintained an elite 89.6% pass accuracy (526 successful passes), won 51 duels (57.3% success rate), and registered 39 aerial duel wins (56.5% success rate) in 17 appearances.

key_players.name: Tahith Chong
key_players.performance_stats: For Sheffield United in the 2025/2026 season, he registered an 83.3% pass completion rate, created 12 chances, and completed 11 dribbles. He has established himself as a focal point for the national team, netting 3 goals in his first 6 international caps.

key_players.name: Juninho Bacuna
key_players.performance_stats: Playing for FC Volendam in the 2025/2026 season, he recorded a 69.9% pass completion rate, executed 17 tackles, won 71 duels, and completed 25 accurate long balls across 13 domestic league appearances.
